findings.problem: The readability rewrite turned 'the habit of keeping a rapiarium' into 'Each of them kept a rapiarium'. That makes a habit of the movement into a claim about every member, which the old text did not make.
findings.evidence: Revision_Round1.json prose_changes n=3, old: 'a plain, interior, methodical devotion, and the habit of keeping a rapiarium'.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'Each of them kept a rapiarium, a personal notebook of gathered passages to return to.' with 'They had the habit of keeping a rapiarium, a personal notebook of gathered passages to return to.' (Whole field Reading Ease 62.8, FK 8.1.)

findings.problem: 'They knew the Bible by heart' says the barbes had the whole Bible memorized. The old text said only that they 'memorized scripture', and the longDescription of the same rewrite says 'long parts of the Bible'.
findings.evidence: Revision_Round1.json prose_changes n=34 old: 'memorized scripture in the vernacular'; n=33 new: 'They knew long parts of the Bible by heart in their own tongue.'
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'They knew the Bible by heart in their own tongue.' with 'They knew long parts of the Bible by heart in their own tongue.' (Whole field Reading Ease 67.5, FK 6.8.)

findings.problem: 'day-by-day records' overstates the old 'running record'. Colophons note events book by book, not day by day.
findings.evidence: Revision_Round1.json prose_changes n=46 old: 'one of the most detailed running records of ordinary catastrophe and survival'.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'So historians have one of the most detailed day-by-day records of ordinary disaster and survival anywhere in the medieval world.' with 'So historians have a running record of ordinary disaster and survival as full as any in the medieval world.' (Whole field Reading Ease 61.5, FK 8.3. A plain swap of 'running' for 'day-by-day' scores 59.3.)

findings.problem: 'the trial records made to convict them' has no plural antecedent. The sentence before is about 'the movement', so the reader has to guess who 'them' is.
findings.evidence: lollardy.why: 'After a failed rising in 1414, the movement was driven underground. Yet the trial records made to convict them ended up keeping...'
findings.proposed_fix: Replace 'the trial records made to convict them' with 'the trial records made to convict Lollards'. (Whole field Reading Ease 61.0, FK 8.0.)
